# Chapter 29 finite contract

Owner: Issue #51. Shared Publication Projection 1.1.0 / Content Safety Policy 1.2.0 remain unchanged.

- `parent-contract.json`: 90 fixed parent inputs, 32 Artifact references, 12 authored handoff steps and four documentary observations. Native state fields are scoped representatives, not a normalization or full-parent status replacement. Parent checkers retain internal semantics.
- `state-corpus.json`: six bounded input/expected contrasts. These booleans explain Portfolio state selection; they do not confer authority or validate arbitrary operational records. Only CAP29-REV-001 is a published complete record, with null approval/receipt and zero real effects.
- `publication-contract.json`: reviewed whole-document projection identities/digests, full-data/schema/bindings hashes, finite routes and two Source editions. All fields, order and locations are frozen, including preamble and tail.

The finite consumer adds no Markdown/HTML/URL parser, host suffix permission or action exception. Like existing consumers, a closed set of exact repository-document references is structural provenance rather than a network target. The 82 exact projected provenance fields comprise 68 fixed parent-file pointer rows, five verified external reference destinations, and nine prose/code fields containing version/section identifiers, the reserved example or the fixed local command. These are not broad text patterns. Any field, context, location or cardinality change fails closed and requires review. Action scanning always applies. The known shared Policy host-token limitation remains separately owned, not fixed here.

Regression families: Chapter 28 → Chapter 29 final navigation (including the reproduced order-72 misplacement, duplicate order and reversed predecessor); duplicate/missing/aliased artifacts; two roles per bundle; case/version/owner/Authority/evidence/receipt transfer; stage reachability; documentary observation vs system observation; missing vs inconclusive; options and gaps; brief parity; synthetic reviews; approval vs recommendation; actions/deadlines/reassessment; whole-field drift; unsafe preamble/tail and unsupported interpreted syntax; strict JSON and bounded regular-file access. No unbounded fuzz grammar, network collection or model execution.

Run `python3 scripts/check_chapter29_contract.py` with PYTHONHASHSEED 0 / 1 / 7 / 42. `--no-regressions` is the publication preflight and still validates all canonical inputs; it is not a safety bypass. Generation, built-site bytes, browser/search/print/accessibility and actual main Pages are separate gates.

ART-33の主索引表登録も、共有Projectionのtable_rowだけを使って確認する。表外の説明では代用せず、欠落・説明だけ・重複・誤名称・誤章・誤Templateの6負例を拒否する。全成果物の一般的な索引検査や索引全文の安全検査を再実装するものではない。
同一policy fieldの重複除去は共有Projectionの契約として維持し、同一行の重複は索引正本のreviewed input hashで拒否する。索引の意味・構成を改訂するときはこの依存を再レビューする。
